title: GloCAB cropland field boundaries (Brazil, Canada, Russia, Ukraine, USA)
description:
190,832 cropland field boundaries in 22 regions of Brazil, Canada, Russia, Ukraine and the United
States, digitised by hand over 20 m Sentinel-2 imagery by geospatial analysts at the University of
Maryland and quality-checked by a senior team member, as a by-product of the Global Cropland Area
Burned (GloCAB) product. The readme gives each region a mapping date (a month, Table A), which is
each field's determination date here (2016 to 2020, by region).
Where fields were too small to identify, the analyst digitised a larger boundary around several
fields and set the `no_area` flag: those polygons are not true field boundaries.
`predominant_crop` is the predominant crop type of the region, not of the field.

This collection holds 5 editions (2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020), one GeoParquet file per year under `year=<year>/` (hive layout). Read them all at once with the partition glob `s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/glocab/year=*/*.parquet` (S3 through the Source Cooperative proxy, endpoint `https://data.source.coop`; plain https cannot expand `*`); the `data` asset is a copy of the latest edition (2020). Geometries are kept in the source CRS (EPSG:4326). Converted with [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli) into the [fiboa](https://github.com/fiboa/specification) schema; tested queries are in the collection's [AGENTS.md](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/glocab/AGENTS.md).

Boundaries are mapped: an authority delineated them from imagery or survey, with no farmer's declaration behind them.

table:columns.name: region
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `Ctry_Reg`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: predominant_crop
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `CropType`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: metrics:area
table:columns.description: Area of the field, in square meters (m²). Must be > 0 and <= 1,000,000,000. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: A geometry that reflects the footprint of the field, usually a Polygon. Stored in the source CRS (see `proj:code`), not reprojected. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: admin:country_code
table:columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (aka admin0). Two-letter country code for the country that contains the field. ([spec](https://github.com/vecorel/administrative-division-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: determination:datetime
table:columns.description: The last timestamp at which the field did exist and was observed. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: no_area
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `No_Area`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: The bounding box of the field. Per-feature covering column (GeoParquet 1.1), in the source CRS. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

partition:keys.name: year
partition:keys.description: Edition year of the source dataset (the converter variant). Not a column in the files; DuckDB adds it with hive_partitioning=true. Expand the glob through S3 (endpoint data.source.coop, path style); plain https has no listing.

data.title: GloCAB — latest edition (2020) (GeoParquet)
data.description: Byte-identical copy of `year=2020/glocab-2020.parquet`, kept at a stable path so `*/latest/*.parquet` selects the newest edition of every collection.

style-field-size.title: Field size (ha)
style-field-size.description: Fields shaded light to dark by area in hectares (metrics:area / 10 000). Stops at 10, 20, 50 ha, the nice values nearest this dataset's 20th/40th/60th/80th percentiles so each class holds a similar share of fields.

style-outline.title: Field boundaries
style-outline.description: Every field in one colour with a thin outline; for reading the boundaries themselves.
